answer: Ephemeral challenge provenance. Each agent gets a fresh, signed puzzle whose solution depends on a random seed whispered at registration time; the seed is discarded after use and never reused. Answers are checked against the live seed, so replaying a captured solution fails the canyon of mismatched state. To field N identities, an attacker must solve N distinct puzzles within the seed window, paying N times the compute plus coordination latency; a single yarrow of reuse collapses the whole batch, forcing full re-registration.
